categories.title: Roadmap step
criteria: Implements exactly the ROADMAP.md step named in the pull request title, and ticks its box in the same change
Every behaviour the step describes works through glyphhound scan, not only inside a helper
Nothing the step asks for is missing, stubbed or left as a TODO

categories.title: Detection safety
criteria: Detection never gets weaker: no sink, de-obfuscation, fixture or test is removed, loosened or skipped; every malicious fixture still gates and the benign fixtures and corpus still have zero findings
Nothing scanned today stops being scanned or starts exiting 0: an input that cannot be read or parsed exits 2 and is reported, never skipped
Templates are never rendered outside the --confirm sandbox, weights are never downloaded, and no new network call is added
A value taken from a template or model and shown to the user (human, Markdown, JSON, SARIF) cannot inject markup, escape codes or links

categories.title: Correctness
criteria: Exit codes hold: 0 clean, 1 a finding gates CI, 2 the scan could not run
JSON and SARIF stay valid (SARIF against the vendored 2.1.0 schema), and with one target every format is unchanged
Odd input is handled without a crash: empty, unreadable or huge files, bad encodings, symlinks, truncated GGUF headers

categories.title: Tests
criteria: python -m pytest passes offline, and every new behaviour has a test in tests/
Tests cover real edge cases, not only the happy path, and never use the network
Tests use temporary directories and committed fixtures, never the developer's home directory

categories.title: Code quality and docs
criteria: jinja2 stays the only runtime dependency, and it runs on Python 3.10 to 3.13
Matches the code's existing style: small functions, the same naming, no dead code or duplicate helpers
README Usage section and CHANGELOG.md change where behaviour changed
